description: Update an accepted risk: change its status (e.g. MATERIALISED or CLOSED), owner, review date, mitigation or follow-up work items. Only the fields you pass change. Requires `write` scope.

acceptedUntilMilestoneId.description: Program milestone id the risk is accepted until.

followUpWorkItemIds.description: Work items that will retire the risk.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ownerUid.description: Owner user id. Defaults to the key holder.

reviewBy.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD the risk must be reviewed again.

title.description: Short statement of the accepted risk.

trigger.description: The condition under which this becomes a real problem.

name: anyforge_update_risk
title: Update risk
